title: SoK: From Generation to Consumption of Privacy Documents in Software Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.12511v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Privacy documents (e.g., privacy policies) are a central mechanism through which digital services disclose data practices and seek user consent. Over the past decades, research on privacy documents has expanded significantly, encompassing not only traditional privacy policies but also short notices (e.g., privacy labels) and interface-level transparency mechanisms. As this research area continues to grow, it has become increasingly difficult to obtain a coherent view of how privacy documents are created, analyzed, evaluated, and maintained across their lifecycle. This SoK provides a unified, lifecycle-oriented view of privacy documents from a software engineering perspective. We systematically review and analyze 290 papers published between 2010 and 2025, organizing them around five research questions that examine how privacy documents are (1) defined and scoped, (2) generated, (3) analyzed and extracted, (4) checked for inconsistencie

translated_title: 从生成到消费：软件系统中隐私文档的系统化知识综述（SoK）
translated_abstract: 隐私文档（如隐私政策）是数字服务披露数据实践并寻求用户同意的核心机制。在过去几十年中，关于隐私文档的研究显著扩展，不仅涵盖传统隐私政策，还包括简短通知（如隐私标签）和界面级透明度机制。随着该研究领域的持续增长，要获得关于隐私文档在其生命周期中如何创建、分析、评估和维护的统一视角变得越来越困难。本SoK从软件工程角度提供了隐私文档的统一、生命周期导向视图。我们系统性地回顾并分析了2010年至2025年间发表的290篇论文，围绕五个研究问题展开，考察隐私文档如何（1）被定义和界定，（2）生成，（3）分析和提取，（4）检查不一致性。
tldr: 本文从软件工程视角对2010至2025年间290篇隐私文档研究论文进行了系统综述，提出了生命周期导向的统一框架，以理解隐私文档在定义、生成、分析和一致性检查等环节的现状与挑战。
en_tdlr: This SoK provides a unified, lifecycle-oriented framework for privacy documents from a software engineering perspective, systematically reviewing 290 papers from 2010 to 2025 to understand their definition, generation, analysis, and inconsistency checking.
